chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 523 — The Inch Gold Pavilion
chapter_meta_description: Han Li reaches Black Stone City, attends a cold-blooded auction, and makes a clean break. He then heads to the Inch Gold Pavilion to seek an ancient herb specialist.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 523: The Inch Gold Pavilion
og_description: Han Li reaches a new city, endures a brutal auction of Human Furnaces, and coldly parts ways with his group. He then heads to the local material shop to find a specialist.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch 523 — The Inch Gold Pavilion
twitter_description: Han Li reaches a new city, skips a terrible auction, and heads straight for the real prize: a specialist in ancient herbs at the Inch Gold Pavilion.

lore_anchors.definition: A person, often a female cultivator with low cultivation, purchased and used as a consumable resource to boost a more powerful cultivator's foundation through forced dual cultivation. A key symbol of the *Mortal Stream*'s institutionalized cruelty.

The third major realm of cultivation, where a cultivator condenses their qi into a solid golden core within their dantian. This grants a lifespan of roughly 500 years and immense power, placing them among the highest echelons of the mortal realm.
The largest and most famous raw material shop in Black Stone City, claiming to be able to procure any ingredient one can name.
The auction house in Black Stone City where Han Li and the others attend the mediocre auction.
A magical talisman used by cultivators to send short messages or signals over a distance.
A private communication technique that directly sends one's voice into another's ear using spiritual sense, undetectable by others without a higher cultivation level.
The specific island in the Outer Star Seas where Black Stone City is located, a major hub for cultivators.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't anyone bid for the Human Furnaces?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Xu Yun explains they were too low in cultivation to be of practical use to higher-level cultivators. In the ruthless economy of the cultivation world, they were a bad investment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li leave the group so abruptly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was bored with the auction and had his own agenda. He used a flash of his Core Formation aura to intimidate the others into silence and left for the Inch Gold Pavilion.

Han Li only knows the ancient, pre-historical name for a key ingredient for his Foundation Establishment or Core Formation pill. Modern shops often use different names, so he needs a scholar who specializes in ancient formulas.
Gu Yu is a Qi Condensation scholar employed by the Inch Gold Pavilion for his expertise in ancient pill formulas and spirit herbs. He is the specialist that Han Li specifically asks to see.
